name: Git
summary: One git atom, four actions: checkout a repository into the workspace (init+fetch, credentials, submodules, recent tag), push and verify the remote, changelog since the last tag, tag with GIT_TAG_NAME/GIT_TAG_MESSAGE.
description: Replaces the separate git-checkout, git-push and git-changelog atoms (and absorbs git-tag-message): the specialised parameters are hidden by rely, so the step form shows only what the chosen action uses.
author: hummerstudio
